name: Pilot A: five hotel review pages
why: Each page carries exactly two destinations (its own hotel and the Da Nang city list), so the pilot needs six dashboard-generated links. Hotels are VERIFIED/high-confidence matches with no open owner decision. Marriott is excluded (two Trip.com listings, support question 9 is open). Ranked by Search Console impressions among eligible hotels.
caveat: Search Console shows only 0-3 clicks per quarter on these pages (about 623 clicks across the whole site). A genuine pilot booking inside 30 days is unlikely: plan for a longer window or consider the traffic-weighted alternative in PILOT-PLAN.md.
